arxiv-2107-12856.title: Understanding Degeneracy of Two-Point Correlation Functions via Debye Random Media
arxiv-2107-12856.creator: Murray Skolnick, Salvatore Torquato
arxiv-2107-12856.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Murray Skolnick, Salvatore Torquato. It is well-known that the degeneracy of two-phase microstructures with the same volume fraction and two-point correlation function S 2 ​ ( 𝐫 ) S_{2}(\mathbf{r}) is generally infinite. To elucidate the degeneracy problem explicitly, we examine Debye random media , which are entirely defined by a purely exponentially decaying two-point correlation function S 2 ​ ( r ) S_{2}(r) . In this work, we consider three different classes of Debye random media.

arxiv-2111-02166.title: Spectral resolutions in effect algebras
arxiv-2111-02166.creator: Anna Jenčová, Sylvia Pulmannová
arxiv-2111-02166.description: Abstract Effect algebras were introduced as an abstract algebraic model for Hilbert space effects representing quantum mechanical measurements. We study additional structures on an effect algebra E E that enable us to define spectrality and spectral resolutions for elements of E E akin to those of self-adjoint operators.

arxiv-2112-10979.title: Mott Insulator-Density Ordered Superfluid Transition and “Shamrock Transition” in a Frustrated Triangle Lattice
arxiv-2112-10979.creator: Ce Wang, Yu Chen
arxiv-2112-10979.description: Abstract Density order is usually a consequence of the competition between long-range and short-range interactions. Here we report a density ordered superfluid emergent from a homogeneous Mott insulator due to the competition between frustrations and local interactions. This transition is found in a Bose-Hubbard model on a frustrated triangle lattice with an extra pairing term.

arxiv-2206-00044.title: Order statistics from exchangeable random variables are always sufficient
arxiv-2206-00044.creator: Nickos Papadatos
arxiv-2206-00044.description:
A 2022 arXiv research paper by Nickos Papadatos. Let ( X 1 , … , X n ) (X_{1},\ldots,X_{n}) be an exchangeable random vector with distribution function F F , and denote by Y 1 ≤ ⋯ ≤ Y n Y_{1}\leq\cdots\leq Y_{n} the corresponding order statistics. We show that the conditional distribution of ( X 1 , … , X n ) (X_{1},\ldots,X_{n}) given ( Y 1 , … , Y n ) (Y_{1},\ldots,Y_{n}) does not depend on F F . MSC
: Primary 62B05; Secondary 62G30.

arxiv-2305-13899.title: Sequence-Level Knowledge Distillation for Class-Incremental End-to-End Spoken Language Understanding
arxiv-2305-13899.creator: Umberto Cappellazzo 1 , Muqiao Yang 2 , Daniele Falavigna 3 , Alessio Brutti 3
arxiv-2305-13899.description: Abstract The ability to learn new concepts sequentially is a major weakness for modern neural networks, which hinders their use in non-stationary environments. Their propensity to fit the current data distribution to the detriment of the past acquired knowledge leads to the catastrophic forgetting issue.

arxiv-2311-03637.title: The detection of polarized x-ray emission from the magnetar 1E 2259+586 2023 The detection of polarized x-ray emission from the magnetar 1E 2259+586 – List of Affiliations
arxiv-2311-03637.creator: Jeremy Heyl, Roberto Taverna, Roberto Turolla, Gian Luca Israel, Mason Ng, Demet Kirmizibayrak, Denis González-Caniulef, Ilaria Caiazzo, Silvia Zane, Steven R. Ehlert, Michela Negro, Iván Agudo, Lucio Angelo Antonelli, Matteo Bachetti, Luca Baldini, Wayne H. Baumgartner, Ronaldo Bellazzini, Stefano
arxiv-2311-03637.description: Abstract We report on IXPE, NICER and XMM-Newton observations of the magnetar 1E 2259+586. We find that the source is significantly polarized at about or above 20% for all phases except for the secondary peak where it is more weakly polarized.

arxiv-2502-19272.title: Highly Localised Droplet Clustering in Shallow Cumulus Clouds
arxiv-2502-19272.creator: Birte Thiede, Michael L. Larsen, Freja Nordsiek, Oliver Schlenczek, Eberhard Bodenschatz, Gholamhossein Bagheri
arxiv-2502-19272.description: Abstract The growth, lifetime, number density, and size of water droplets in warm atmospheric clouds determine the evolution, lifetime and light transmission properties of those clouds. These small-scale cloud properties, in addition to precipitation initiation, have strong implications for the Earth’s energy budget since warm clouds cover large geographic areas.

arxiv-2503-03238.title: FANS - F ormal An swer S election for Natural Language Math Reasoning Using Lean4
arxiv-2503-03238.creator: Jiarui Yao, Ruida Wang, Tong Zhang
arxiv-2503-03238.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have displayed astonishing abilities in various tasks, especially in text generation, classification, question answering, etc. However, the reasoning ability of LLMs still faces many debates. The inherent ambiguity of Natural Language (NL) limits LLMs’ ability to perform verifiable reasoning, making its answers lack coherence and trustworthy support.

arxiv-2507-21591.title: Hierarchical Graph Neural Network for Compressed Speech Steganalysis
arxiv-2507-21591.creator: Mustapha Hemis, Hamza Kheddar, Mohamed Chahine Ghanem *, Bachir Boudraa
arxiv-2507-21591.description: Abstract Steganalysis methods based on deep learning (DL) often struggle with computational complexity and challenges in generalizing across different datasets. In the specific case of voice-over-IP (VoIP) speech streams, detection is particularly challenging because the low bit-rate encoding creates complex, relational dependencies between speech frames.

catholic-encyclopedia-1913-maximilian-va.creator: Gertrude Dana Steele
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-maximilian-va.description: Article 'Maximilian van Der Sandt' from the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the 15-volume English-language reference work published 1907-1914 by Robert Appleton Company.

doe-osti-3365386-novel-aqueous-geochemis.title: NOVEL AQUEOUS GEOCHEMISTRY AT EXTREME CONDITIONS
doe-osti-3365386-novel-aqueous-geochemis.creator: Unknown
doe-osti-3365386-novel-aqueous-geochemis.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. The overall aim of the project is to develop quantitative predictive geochemical modelling of aqueous fluid-rock-hydrocarbon interactions in the Earth by building on recent state-of-the-art experimental data and ab initio calculations of extreme aqueous fluid chemistry

pmc-10573702.title: Observation of Weibull, Lognormal, and Gamma Distributions in Electrodeposited Cu and Cu-Ag Particles
pmc-10573702.creator: Yunkai Sun, Giovanni Zangari, Frank Czerwinski, Olga Grishenkova
pmc-10573702.description: In this work, the nearest-neighbor distances and Voronoi cell features of Cu-Ag deposits were analyzed and fitted with Lognormal, Weibull, and Gamma distributions. The nearest-neighbor distance distributions of the samples were compared with those of complete spatially random points, showing spatial inhomogeneity due to the nucleation exclusion effect.

pmc-10582386.title: The impact of thermal treatment on the mechanical properties and thermal insulation of building materials enhanced with two types of volcanic scoria additives
pmc-10582386.creator: Shoroog Alraddadi
pmc-10582386.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The need to substitute cement with eco-friendly building materials has increased in recent years, and attempts to enhance the mechanical and thermal insulation properties of these materials are ongoing. Therefore, the present study aims to use two different types of scoria as substitutes for cement in building materials and investigate the impact of thermal treatment on improving mechanical characteristics and thermal insulation.

pmc-10595298.title: Healthiness and sustainability of food service in healthcare settings in Germany
pmc-10595298.creator: N J Lambrecht, L M Pörtner, L Schlenger, S Gabrysch
pmc-10595298.description: BackgroundCurrent dietary patterns threaten individual and planetary health. Healthcare settings can set a positive example for dietary change, but data on the quality of food they offer is scarce. The aim of our study was to assess the environmental footprint and nutritional quality of food service in hospitals and nursing homes in Germany.

pmc-11434363.title: Clinical and Dermoscopic Patterns of Basal Cell Carcinoma and Its Mimickers in Skin of Color: A Practical Summary
pmc-11434363.creator: Emmanouil Karampinis, Konstantina-Eirini Georgopoulou, Elli Kampra, Efterpi Zafiriou, Aimilios Lallas, Elizabeth Lazaridou, Zoe Apalla, Biswanath Behera, Enzo Errichetti
pmc-11434363.description: The diagnosis of basal cell carcinoma (BCC) in dark phototypes can be a challenging task due to the lack of relevant clues and its variable presentation. In this regard, there is growing evidence that dermoscopy may benefit the recognition of BCC even for skin of color (SoC).

pmc-11587717.title: Effect of content framing in smoking prevention campaigns on recognition and attitudes: a virtual reality study
pmc-11587717.creator: Solenne Bonneterre, Oulmann Zerhouni, Maréva Barré, Reinout Wiers, Marilisa Boffo
pmc-11587717.description: ObjectivesAnti-tobacco campaigns often suffer from a lack of systematic evaluation and may not always have the intended impact on the target population. Our research adopted immersive virtual reality (iVR) to systematically evaluate preventive anti-tobacco messages in a controlled setting while mimicking a naturalistic and ecological environment.

pmc-11657555.title: Emergency contraceptive pill awareness in Bangladesh: missed opportunities in antenatal care and family welfare assistant visits
pmc-11657555.creator: Tasnim Ara, Shahnaj Sultana Sathi, Shafayatul Islam Shiblee, Sumaiya Nusrat Esha, Md Tazvir Amin, Md Mahabubur Rahman
pmc-11657555.description: BackgroundDespite high coverage of antenatal care (ANC) and family welfare assistant (FWA) visits, emergency contraceptive pill (ECP) awareness is critically low in Bangladesh. We aim to investigate the missed opportunities in generating ECP awareness through ANC and FWA visit programs; and assess the missed opportunities and sociodemographic discrimination in receiving family planning (FP) counseling during ANC.

pmc-12594989.title: Prevalence, bacterial etiology, and antimicrobial susceptibility patterns of urinary tract infections among pregnant women in rural West Amhara, Ethiopia
pmc-12594989.creator: Mulatu Melese Derebe, Unmesha Roy Paladhi, Firehiwot Workneh, Abaineh Munshea, Gizachew Yismaw, Kalkidan Yibeltal, Nebiyou Fasil, Alemayehu Worku, Tsehaynesh Gebreyesus, Wudu Tafere, Alem Tsega, Parul Christian, Rose L Molina, Blair J Wylie, Yemane Berhane, Anne C C Lee
pmc-12594989.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Urinary Tract Infections (UTIs) in pregnant women can lead to pyelonephritis and preterm birth. Our objective was to assess UTI prevalence, etiology, antimicrobial susceptibility, and risk factors among pregnant women receiving antenatal care in rural Amhara, Ethiopia. From a pregnancy cohort in West Gojjam and South Gondor, we consecutively enrolled 604 women from 12 health centers and screened for UTI at ≤ 24 weeks gestational age from August 2020 to June 2022.

pmc-12718510.title: Mendelian Randomization Integrating GWAS and eQTL Data Reveals DAAM1, a Potential Immune-Related Biomarker for Breast Cancer Prognosis
pmc-12718510.creator: Gang Chen, Kun Zhang, Yidan Wang, Zhe Zhang, Jianqiao Cao, Ge Gao, Chao Yu, Yuanping Dai, Guangdong Qiao, Yizi Cong
pmc-12718510.description: BackgroundThe immune response plays a critical role in determining the prognosis of breast cancer (BC) patients. However, the underlying molecular mechanisms linking immune regulation to BC progression remain uncleared. This study aims to identify and functionally validate key immune-related genes that mechanistically impact on BC prognosis.

pmc-13032828.title: Success with incrementally faster times to endovascular therapy (SWIFT-EVT): A systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13032828.creator: Brittney Legere, Ahmed Mohamed, Salah Elsherif, Razan Saqqur, David Schoenfeld, Anna M Slebonick, Michael McCartin, James Price, Kori S Zachrison, Jonathan A Edlow, Maher Saqqur, Ashfaq Shuaib, Stephen H Thomas
pmc-13032828.description: Background:A major systematic review and meta-analysis assessing trial data through 2014 (the Highly Effective Reperfusion Evaluated in Multiple Endovascular Stroke Trials, HERMES) demonstrated that particularly over the initial six hours of acute ischemic stroke (AIS), rapid performance of endovascular therapy (EVT) markedly improves outcomes.

pmc-13347380.title: Recurrence of Basal Cell Carcinoma across Different Treatment Modalities: A Nationwide Study with 8 Years of Follow-up and Modelled Prediction
pmc-13347380.creator: Johan Sieborg, Emily Wenande, Alexander Egeberg, Henrik Sølvsten, Ulrikke Lei, Emilie Westerlin Kjeldsen, Merete Haedersdal
pmc-13347380.description: Despite the rising incidence of basal cell carcinoma (BCC), few studies have compared treatment outcomes or predicted recurrences using nationwide real-world datasets. Hence, the objective was to investigate and compare recurrence rates of nodular BCC (nBCC) and superficial BCC (sBCC) following treatment with standard excision (SE), curettage, cryotherapy, photodynamic therapy and imiquimod.

pmc-13621750.title: CSF1R inhibition following antibody mediated demyelination has limited impact on remyelination
pmc-13621750.creator: Lisa C. Golden, Graham C. Peet, Rebecca E. Rodriguez, Nicholas J. Jahahn, Gregory P. Owens, Jeffrey L. Bennett, Wendy B. Macklin
pmc-13621750.description: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a chronic, immune-mediated, demyelinating disease of the central nervous system. B cell depleting treatments are effective MS therapies, and while antibodies may serve as a biomarker, little is known about how they participate in MS pathology.

pmc-13628429.title: Eosinophilia in the Tropics: Should Empirical Anthelmintic Treatment Be Considered Standard Practice? A Prospective Cohort Study
pmc-13628429.creator: Smith Kungwankiattichai, Patsharaporn T. Sarasombath, Pattaraporn Tunsing, Weerapat Owattanapanich

pmc-13664432.title: Preoperative White Matter Disease Severity Predicts Intraoperative Cerebral Desaturation During Carotid Endarterectomy
pmc-13664432.creator: Márk Matus, Ágnes Dóra Sándor, Olaf Aleksander Ziółkiewicz, Melissa Pawin-On Brinning, Andrea Varga, Péter Sótonyi, Rita Magyar-Stang, Zsuzsanna Mihály
pmc-13664432.description: Objective: Carotid endarterectomy carries the risk of cerebral ischemia during carotid clamping. Traditional risk stratification relies on anatomic factors such as contralateral stenosis, yet these predictors demonstrate limited sensitivity for intraoperative hypoperfusion. White matter hyperintensities (WMH), quantified by the Fazekas scale, reflect chronic cerebral small vessel disease and impaired cerebrovascular reactivity.
